messages:
harper: heads-up — onboarding report: sample-kit users hit duplicate order records when a 429 coincided with our auth refresh. short thread.

zane: can you paste a tiny trace? wondering if it's client replay or server side double-processing.

harper: minimal flow:
```
client POST /v1/orders -> 429
SDK: kick off refresh (background)
SDK: retry POST immediately (no idempotency-key) -> 201
refresh completes, original attempt also retries -> 201
```
server ends up with order-123 and order-124, both valid.

mei: oh, so the SDK triggered two distinct POSTs. do different language SDKs behave the same?

harper: not exactly. Python and Go SDKs wait for an in-flight refresh promise and then retry; JS and mobile SDKs currently fire a retry path concurrently to avoid blocking latency.

zane: parity issue then. options: 1) make all SDKs await refresh before retry (safer), 2) enable auto idempotency generation in SDKs (opt-in), 3) change sample-kit to add X-Idempotency-Key examples and conservative backoff.

harper: proposal: sample-kit flips to include idempotency by default (+ README blurb), JS/mobile SDKs add config "awaitRefreshOnRetry=true" default true for starters, and global SDK default backoff: base=1.4s mult=2 max=10s jitter=0.3 retries=3 for 429/5xx.

zane: i like that. small ask: telemetry flag so we can surface "retry_sent_during_refresh" events. we need numbers before rolling changes wide.

ci-bot: created test job simulating 429 + delayed refresh: https://ci.redwood/jobs/5523 queued.

sdk-maintainer: i'm going to open an MR to gate retries behind the refresh promise for JS SDK and add an opt-in auto-idempotency option (safe_replay_protection). will also add a short migration note. MR: https://git.redwood/sdk/mr/1102

harper: perfect. i'll update the sample-kit, add the idempotency example (`X-Idempotency-Key: uuid.v4()`), and add a lint that warns if POST examples lack the header. also will add quick UX guidance: debounce submit buttons on mobile.

mei: thanks — once MR merges let's ship a patch to sample-kit and include a short "why duplicates happen" FAQ in onboarding docs. :sparkles:
